disclosure.en: This video uses an AI-generated voiceover.

note: Voices are the model's own named speakers, described by text only. Nothing imitates or refers to a real person; no reference recordings are used.
edge_fade_note: 10 ms raised-cosine fade at each sentence's start and end - accepted by the user 10 Nov 2026 (B1.2 corrections). It changes only the quiet edges (sentence ends at about -40 to -43 dBFS); every other sample is identical to the listening-approved audio. 0 = off.

sentence_limit.note: Approved 10 Nov: a sentence estimated above 5.5 s of speech or above about 70 spoken characters is marked for review (never split or rewritten automatically); approval needs --checked. Rates measured in B1.2 (speech seconds per spoken character, 1.0x). Longer sentences need more memory.
